title: troximon heterophyllum
intro: Troximon heterophyllum, commonly known as Heterophylla, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is known to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its potential in treating conditions such as arthritis and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Troximon heterophyllum include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial agent, and its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpenoids and phenolic compounds, have been shown to exhibit these effects.
